# BR-002 — Vendor Business Case for Appointment Reminder Product

## References

### Derived From
- None identified.

### Related To
- [BR-001 — Appointment Reminders for Small Clinics](BR-001-appointment-reminders-for-small-clinics.md) — the clinic-side problem this product would address.

### Supporting Artifacts
- None identified.

## Business Context and Problem

The company currently has no recurring-revenue product. Automated appointment reminders for independent clinics has been identified as a candidate product to build and sell in order to establish one.

## Objectives and Desired Outcomes

- Establish a recurring-revenue product line for the company.

## Stakeholders

| Stakeholder | Interest or role |
|---|---|
| Founders | Own the go/no-go decision and overall strategic direction for the product |
| Sales lead | Owns go-to-market execution and pricing for the product |

## Scope

### In Scope
- The business case for building and selling the reminder product: revenue model, pricing approach, go-to-market strategy

### Out of Scope
- Clinic-side product requirements (see BR-001)
- Product design and build itself

## Business Requirements

- **BR-002-R001** — The business shall define a pricing model for the reminder product.
- **BR-002-R002** — The business shall define a go-to-market and sales approach for reaching independent clinics.
- **BR-002-R003** — The business shall define a recurring-revenue target for the product.

## Constraints and Dependencies

- Budget: TBD.
- Timeline: TBD.

## Success Measures

- Recurring revenue achieved — Target: TBD.

## Assumptions and Risks

- **Assumption:** This product's feasibility depends on the clinic-side requirements and constraints captured in BR-001.
- **Risk:** TBD.

## Open Questions

- What pricing model will be used (e.g., per-clinic subscription, per-message, tiered)? Owner: Unknown.
- What is the target recurring-revenue figure, and by what date? Owner: Unknown.
- What go-to-market channel(s) will be used to reach independent clinics? Owner: Unknown.
- What budget and timeline exist for building and launching the product? Owner: Unknown.
